title: Homemade Kimbap Rolls
description: A classic Korean dish, kimbap is a simple, easy-to-make snack or meal made with rice and various fillings wrapped in a paper-thin sheet of seaweed.

ingredients.name: Dried Seaweed Sheets (Nori)
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores

instructions: Prepare the rice by cooking it according to package instructions.
Cut the seaweed sheets into 8-10 equal pieces.
Prepare your vegetable filling of choice.
Lay a piece of seaweed flat on a cutting board.
Spread a thin layer of rice onto the seaweed, leaving a 1-inch border at the top.
Add your chosen vegetable filling in the middle of the rice.
Roll the kimbap tightly but gently, applying even pressure.
Slice the kimbap rolls into individual pieces and serve.
